Explain the example for make a mixin recipe

blocks.text: A mixin is a named group of CSS choices. Include it wherever you want those choices copied into a rule.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `@include` inserts the named mixin's style declarations into the current selector rule.
`@mixin` defines a reusable group of style declarations. Parameters in parentheses let each call choose a value.

blocks.text: Both classes get padding and round corners. Changing the recipe changes both after the next build.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Defining a mixin does not output a style by itself. Use @include to put it into a rule.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Include soft-box inside one more class named tip.
